title: Debug-gym: an environment for AI coding tools to learn how to debug code like programmers
description: Developers spend a lot of time debugging code. Learn how debug-gym can equip AI agents to help, enabling them to set breakpoints, navigate the codebase, and print runtime variable values on demand, so they better understand the code and its execution flow.
